in_marathi.name: Vitransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vitransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vitransh is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Vitra' which means to conquer or destroy and 'Ansh' which means essence or form. This name is believed to bring courage, strength and victory to the one who bears it.
